# Purpose

Validates URLs in the package sources in the same way CRAN does, i.e. using
`tools::check_package_urls()`, which is what `R CMD check --as-cran` runs. This
ensures that any URL flagged by this workflow would also be flagged by CRAN
(and vice versa).

Source: [`.github/workflows/links.yml`](https://github.com/pharmaverse/admiralci/blob/main/.github/workflows/links.yml)

# Inputs

| Name | Description | Default |
|------|-------------|---------|
| `r-version` | The version of R to use | `"release"` |

# Other Resources

- `.lycheeignore`: Can be used to ignore specific links during checks (e.g.,
 URLs which are valid but cannot be reached from GitHub runners). Each line is
 treated as a regular expression and any URL matching one of them is ignored.
 Empty lines and lines starting with `#` are skipped. See
 [`admiral/.lycheeignore`](https://github.com/pharmaverse/admiral/blob/main/.lycheeignore)
 for an example.

# Jobs

## Job: `links`

Validates URLs in the package sources.

### Condition

Runs unless the commit message contains `[skip links]`.

### Steps

1. **Checkout repo**  
   Uses [actions/checkout](https://github.com/actions/checkout) to check out the repository.
2. **Setup R**  
   Uses [r-lib/actions/setup-r](https://github.com/r-lib/actions/tree/v2-branch/setup-r) to install R.
3. **Setup pandoc**  
   Uses [r-lib/actions/setup-pandoc](https://github.com/r-lib/actions/tree/v2-branch/setup-pandoc) to install pandoc.
   It is required (together with `{xml2}`) to extract URLs from `README.md` and `NEWS.md`.
4. **Install R packages**  
   Installs `{curl}` and `{xml2}`.
5. **Check URLs as CRAN does**  
   - Checks the URLs in `DESCRIPTION`, `man/*.Rd`, `CITATION`, `NEWS`,
     `README.md`, and `NEWS.md` in the same way `tools::check_package_urls()`
     does, i.e., the same way CRAN does.
   - Checks the URLs in the vignette sources (`vignettes/**/*.Rmd`, `*.qmd`,
     `*.md`) as well. CRAN does not check these. Only absolute `http(s)` URLs
     are checked, i.e., links to other vignettes or to help pages are skipped.
   - Removes URLs matching a pattern from `.lycheeignore`.
   - Writes a table of the problematic URLs to the job summary and a more
     detailed report to `links-results.md`.
   - Fails the workflow if any problematic URLs remain. The error message lists
     them.
6. **Upload results**
   Uploads `links-results.md` as the `links-results` artifact. In addition to
   the table shown in the job summary, the report lists for each problematic
   URL the files and line numbers it occurs in and, for a URL which was moved,
   the URL to use instead. If the check passed, it states how many URLs were
   checked and which ones were ignored.

# Triggers

The workflow is triggered by the following [GitHub Actions events](https://docs.github.com/en/actions/using-workflows/events-that-trigger-workflows):

- [`push`](https://docs.github.com/en/actions/using-workflows/events-that-trigger-workflows#push): On pushes to `main`, `devel`, and `pre-release` branches.
- [`pull_request`](https://docs.github.com/en/actions/using-workflows/events-that-trigger-workflows#pull_request): On pull requests (opened, synchronize, reopened, ready_for_review) targeting `main`, `devel`, or `pre-release`.
- [`workflow_dispatch`](https://docs.github.com/en/actions/using-workflows/events-that-trigger-workflows#workflow_dispatch): Manual trigger.
- [`workflow_call`](https://docs.github.com/en/actions/using-workflows/events-that-trigger-workflows#workflow_call): Triggered by another workflow.

# Concurrency

- Jobs are grouped by pull request number or branch and cancel in-progress jobs for the same group.
